[02:14.50-02:19.80] (camera) Medium two-shot as Father Thomas extends his open right hand between them.

[02:22.80-02:24.00] (camera) Close-up of Catherine gazing up at him, her eyes glistening in the candlelight.
[02:23.00-02:24.00] CATHERINE (Intimate): "We always have."
[02:24.00-02:24.75] (camera) Extreme close-up as Father Thomas gently raises his other hand and cups Catherine's cheek tenderly, her hand resting against his chest as she leans into his touch before cutting to black.

[00:00.00-00:00.10] (scene) INT. ABANDONED BEDCHAMBER – PRE-DAWN
[00:00.00-00:01.80] (camera) High overhead birds-eye shot looking straight down at the unkempt bed, where Catherine lies curled in a silk chemise against Father Thomas's bare chest.
[00:00.00-00:02.00] (action) Father Thomas lies flat on his back, breathless, while Catherine rests beside him, her fingers tracing across his bare skin.
[00:01.80-00:05.80] CATHERINE (Playful, Seductive): "A man in your collar isn't supposed to have that much left in him, Thomas."
[00:01.80-00:07.00] (camera) Low-angle medium close-up on Catherine looking down adoringly into Father Thomas's face, a single candle flickering in the dark background.
[00:05.80-00:07.20] (action) Catherine runs her hand gently down his chest, smiling with triumphant affection.
[00:07.00-00:11.80] (camera) Close-up on Father Thomas turning his head toward her on the pillow, his voice raspy and dry.
[00:07.20-00:11.20] FATHER THOMAS (Low, Ironical): "A man in my collar isn't supposed to be in this bed at all."
[00:11.80-00:15.80] (camera) Close-up pushing in on Catherine as she leans lower over his face, her gaze sharpening with dangerous intimacy.
[00:12.00-00:15.50] CATHERINE (Intense, Whispering): "Then let's stop pretending this was only appetite."
[00:15.80-00:18.80] (camera) Medium two-shot from the side as both sit up in bed, sheets pulled up around their waists.
[00:16.80-00:18.50] CATHERINE (Direct, Transactional): "Name your price."
[00:18.80-00:26.50] (camera) Medium profile close-up on Father Thomas sitting up tall and bare-chested, Catherine resting her hand firmly over his heart.
[00:19.40-00:25.00] FATHER THOMAS (Calculated, Demanding): "The west territory. Tax collection, all of it. Routed through my office."
[00:26.50-00:30.50] (camera) Slight pull back as Catherine pulls her hand back slightly, staring at him in disbelief.
[00:27.20-00:30.20] CATHERINE (Scoffing, Incredulous): "That's not absolution, Thomas. That's a fortune."
[00:30.50-00:35.80] (camera) Two-shot centering on Father Thomas leaning toward her, his expression resolute and uncompromising.
[00:31.00-00:35.00] FATHER THOMAS (Steady, Cold): "Absolution is free. Discretion has a price."
[00:35.80-00:39.80] (camera) Tight profile close-up between their faces, golden candlelight illuminating Catherine's jaw as she raises her hand to touch his cheek.
[00:36.50-00:39.40] CATHERINE (Soft, Calculating): "Unsupervised. In your hands alone."
[00:39.80-00:43.00] (camera) Tight close-up as Father Thomas reaches up and firmly clasps Catherine's hand at his neck.
[00:40.40-00:42.50] FATHER THOMAS (Grave): "For as long as it holds."
